title: The Drink with My Name
summary: Jackie rehearses his entrance to the Afterlife, poses for a photo, and asks you to help name the drink he will one day order.
description: Jackie wants to rehearse the entrance he will make once he is a legend at the Afterlife in Little China. He asks V to play the crowd, pose for a photo and help name the drink he will one day order.

start.bringUp: Jackie is outside the Afterlife in Little China, staring at the door. He wants to rehearse the entrance he will make when he is a legend, and he asks you to be the crowd.

door.name: the front door of the Afterlife in Little China

stairs.name: the stairs up to the booths in the Afterlife

JW5.open.01.text: There it is. The Afterlife. In a year they'll be chanting my name at that door.

JW5.open.02.text: I want to rehearse. The walk. The nod. The tilt of the chin.

JW5.open.03.text: You're the crowd. Cheer or heckle, but be honest.

JW5.stage.entrance.01.text: Here we go. Chin up. Don't smile, they hate that.

JW5.stage.entrance.02.text: Up the stairs. Slow. Let the booths look.

JW5.stage.entrance.03.text: And the bar. That's where legends order. How'd it look?

JW5.bark.cheer.a.text: Yes! More of that! I'm gonna need a bodyguard for the applause.

JW5.bark.cheer.b.text: Louder! Make the whole bar turn around!

JW5.bark.heckle.a.text: Boo? Boo?! Okay, okay. That's character building.

JW5.bark.heckle.b.text: Keep heckling. Legends need haters. It's practice.

JW5.stage.photo.01.text: Alright. Frame it. Door behind me. Arm up. Make me look like a champion.

JW5.stage.photo.02.text: Look at that. A legend in the making. Send it to Misty.

JW5.stage.drink.01.text: Claire! What goes in a legend's drink? No, listen, I have a recipe.

JW5.stage.drink.02.text: Vodka, ice, lime, ginger beer. And then something... sentimental. I always lose the last word.

JW5.close.01.text: A twist! Perfect. We'll put it on the menu: The Jackie. With a twist.

JW5.close.02.text: Salt. Weird. Okay. A legend can be weird.

JW5.close.03.text: Tequila float. Of course. You know me.

JW5.close.05.text: Write it on a coaster. One day I'll order it and they'll know my name.

g1.asks: Be honest, hermano. How would you like a legend to walk in? Slow or fast?
g1.know: The Afterlife door, three checkpoints (door, stairs, bar), three regulars at the bar, a photo and a drink to come.
g1.secret: This is for his mother and Misty more than for the crowd.

g2.asks: Do I smile? Do I not smile? You're the artist, V.
g2.know: V frames the photo. The Afterlife neon is behind him. The tag got-it closes the shot.

g3.asks: Help me finish it. What's the last ingredient of a good memory?
g3.know: The recipe is vodka over ice, lime and ginger beer. The flourish is open: a twist, salt, a tequila float, or plain. Claire is the bartender and only talks. The coaster is for his name.
g3.secret: He wants the drink to remind Misty of him.
